Paris, France
Artificial Intelligence

Apply now
Meta is seeking PhD candidates through 3-year fixed term contracts to join our Fundamental AI Research (FAIR) Lab. We are committed to advancing the field of artificial intelligence by making fundamental advances in scientific methods and technologies to help interact with and understand our world. We are seeking individuals passionate in areas such as foundational models, Large Language Models, deep learning, computer vision, audio and speech processing, natural language processing, machine learning, reinforcement learning, computational statistics, computational cognitive (neuro)science, and applied mathematics.

Our contracts are 3-year fixed term for candidates with a Masters degree who plan to enroll in a doctorate program offered by an academic institution partnering with Meta.

PhD students joining our team are jointly supervised by academics at the partnering academic lab and research scientists at FAIR. In the spirit of FAIR's general mission, we expect the work to come out of the PhD, both at Meta and the academic partner, to be open science and open source.

FAIR PhD positions will be awarded on a rolling basis and candidates are encouraged to apply early in their search for PhD programs. Applicants are expected to be pursuing a PhD in one of the areas listed above.

To learn more about our research, visit: https://ai.meta.com/research/
AI Research Assistant (PhD) Responsibilities
Perform research to advance the science and technology of intelligent systems
Perform research that improves computational understanding and representation of data
Devise data-driven models of human behavior
Influence progress of relevant research communities by producing publications
Collaborate and increase productivity on existing research projects
Minimum Qualifications
Masters degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience
Knowledge in Machine Learning
Experience programming in at least one language (e.g., Python, C++)
Must obtain work authorization in country of employment at the time of hire, and maintain ongoing work authorization during employment
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with large-scale distributed training or inference systems
Familiarity with modern Deep Learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, JAX)
Research and software engineering experience demonstrated via an internship, work experience, publications, coding competitions, or open-source contributions
Experience building systems based on machine learning, deep learning, or generative AI methods
About Meta
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
